content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be domiciled in Assam or Arunachal Pradesh. For the Warden post, candidates must be female.

rows.qualification: Graduate in any discipline from a Government-recognized Institute/University; must hold a Diploma/Certificate in Computer Application of minimum 6 months duration with proficiency in MS-Word, MS-Excel, MS-PowerPoint; minimum 1 year post-qualification relevant work experience in Government/Semi-Government/PSU/Public Limited/Private organizations.

rows.post_name: Contractual Warden (Female) for School of Nursing
rows.qualification: Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a Government-recognized University/Institute with minimum 1 year post-qualification work experience as Warden in a hostel, OR Diploma in Housekeeping/Catering from a Government-recognized University/Institute with minimum 1 year post-qualification work experience as Warden in a hostel.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Contractual Data Assistant (Medical) Minimum Age: 18 years Maximum Age (General): 40 years Contractual Warden (Female) for School of Nursing Minimum Age: 28 years Maximum Age (General): 50 years Maximum Age (OBC-NCL): 53 years Age relaxation for PwBD and Ex-Servicemen categories is applicable as per Government of India guidelines. Age is reckoned as on the date of registration for the Walk-in Personal Assessment.

content_sections.heading: PwBD Suitability
content_sections.text: Contractual Data Assistant (Medical): a) LV; b) HH; c) OA, BL, OL, OAL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV, MDy; d) ASD (M), SLD, MI; e) MD involving a to d Contractual Warden (Female): a) LV; b) HH; c) OA, OL, CP, LC, Dw, AAV; d) SLD, MI; e) MD involving a to d

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based solely on a Walk-in Personal Assessment carrying a total of 100 marks. Qualifying/pass marks: 50 for all categories. Candidates are assessed on: Professional Knowledge and Skills (concerned discipline), Professional Knowledge and Skills (allied discipline), and Personal Attributes and Soft Skills. Final selection is purely merit-based on marks scored in the assessment, subject to securing the qualifying marks of 50 or above.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: There is no online application for this recruitment. Interested and eligible candidates must report in person for Registration at the venue between 07:00 AM and 09:00 AM on 12 August 2026. Candidates who complete registration within the stipulated time will appear for the Walk-in Personal Assessment on the same day. No candidate will be permitted to register outside the specified date and time window under any circumstances. If the number of registered candidates exceeds venue capacity on 12 August 2026, the assessment for remaining candidates will be carried forward to subsequent day(s). Candidates must carry the following in original plus self-attested photocopies: Filled Personal Bio-Data Form (format provided in the official notification) One recent 3cm x 3cm coloured passport photograph Valid Photo ID Proof and Address Proof issued by a competent Government authority Date of Birth proof (Class 10th Certificate) Class 10th Admit Card, Marksheet and Pass Certificate; qualification marksheets/certificates and experience certificates, as applicable Valid Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC), Non-Creamy Layer Certificate, EWS Income and Asset Certificate, Disability Certificate, Ex-Servicemen Discharge Book, as applicable No Objection Certificate, if currently employed in Government/PSU/Autonomous Body EPF Passbook (if available), Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Bank Passbook No Travelling Allowance or Daily Allowance will be paid for appearing in the assessment; candidates must arrange their own travel and accommodation.

content_sections.heading: Remuneration
content_sections.text: Contractual Data Assistant (Medical) Fixed Emolument: Rs. 21,450 per month (based on attendance, including paid leave/holiday) Variable Emolument: Rs. 825 per day for each working day Contractual Warden (Female) for School of Nursing Fixed Emolument: Rs. 24,960 per month (based on attendance, including paid leave/holiday) Variable Emolument: Rs. 960 per day for each working day Statutory benefits of EPF and Gratuity are applicable. Selected candidates on Maternity Leave will be paid only the Fixed component during that period.

content_sections.heading: Period of Contractual Engagement
content_sections.text: The initial engagement period is 6 months, extendable for three further tenures of 6 months each based on departmental requirement, job performance, conduct, and physical fitness, subject to a maximum total period of 24 months.

Selected candidates on contract cannot take up any other assignment during their engagement and may be placed at any location as decided by the competent authority. Accommodation and all applicable taxes are to be borne by the selected candidate. Candidates are entitled to 6 days of paid leave per 6-month contractual period. faq.question: Q1. Is there an online application process for OIL Data Assistant & Warden recruitment?
faq.answer: No. There is no online application. Candidates must register in person at the venue on 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for these posts?
faq.answer: Only candidates domiciled in Assam or Arunachal Pradesh are eligible. For the Warden post, candidates must be female.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Data Assistant (Medical) post?
faq.answer: Minimum 18 years, Maximum 40 years (General). Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per GoI guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Warden (Female) post?
faq.answer: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline OR Diploma in Housekeeping/Catering from a Government-recognized University/Institute, with minimum 1 year post-qualification work experience as Warden in a hostel.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based solely on a Walk-in Personal Assessment (100 marks). Qualifying marks are 50 for all categories.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in?
faq.answer: Original + self-attested copies of: Filled Bio-Data Form, passport photo, Photo ID & Address Proof, Class 10th certificate, qualification/experience certificates, caste/EWS/PwBD certificates (if applicable), NOC (if employed), EPF Passbook, Aadhaar, PAN, Bank Passbook.

faq.question: Q7. What is the remuneration for the Data Assistant (Medical) post?
faq.answer: Fixed Emolument: ₹21,450 per month; Variable Emolument: ₹825 per day for each working day.

faq.question: Q8. What is the duration of the contract?
faq.answer: Initial engagement is 6 months, extendable up to a maximum of 24 months based on performance and requirement.
